clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the Deadmines, Sneed directs the Defias Brotherhood’s timber work. From the Mast Room, he pilots a heavy shredder of his own design to cut lumber for Edwin VanCleef’s secret juggernaut.

The Defias Brotherhood draws most of its members from human stonemasons and laborers, but an ironclad warship needs skilled trades. Edwin VanCleef brought Sneed in for his engineering knowledge and ruthless efficiency. Sneed works in the Mast Room, beside the underground rail network. There he directs the felling, cutting, and shaping of timber for VanCleef’s colossal dreadnaught.

Sneed cares about cutting costs and meeting quotas, whatever the consequences. He directs the work from a custom shredder fitted with oversized buzz saws. Its blades turn raw trunks into shipbuilding timber in seconds. When intruders corner him, Sneed uses the machine’s armor to grind them down. If it fails, he scrambles from the wreckage and fights barehanded.
